newsitem.title: USA: SCP Pool sees good weather helping sales.
newsitem.headline: SCP Pool sees good weather helping sales.

text.p: SCP Pool Corp, reporting results for the second quarter Tuesday, said it expected sunny weather to help sales in the second half of the year.

"Initial indications are that the positive trends from June are extending into the third quarter, which because of seasonal factors also contributes importantly to our pewrformance for the year as a whole," said chairman W.B. Sexton in a statement.
The distributor of swimming pool supplies posted a $6.4 million net income, or $1.48 a (fully-diluted) share, in the second quarter, compared with a $5.6 million, or $1.30 a share, a year earlier.
The results beat a First Call consensus estimate of four analysts, who had put the company's earnings at $1.38 a share in the second quarter.

"The second-quarter gains were aided by a return to more normal weather conditions during june," Sexton said, adding unseasonable cool temperatures had tempered demand in the early part of the quarter.
"We closed the period on a strong note, however, enabling us to achieve record highs in both net sales and net income," Sexton

SCP Pool's second-quarter sales jumped 45 percent to $124.8 million from 85.9 million last year. Sexton attributed the increase to incremental contributions of centers the company bought last year and internal gains.
The company's stock closed at 21-2/8 Monday.
